hooks.command: bash -c 'BRANCH=$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); [ "$BRANCH" != "main" ] || { echo "{\"block\": true, \"message\": \"main 브랜치 직접 수정 금지. /new-task 이름 으로 브랜치를 만드세요.\"}" >&2; exit 2; }'

bash -c 'cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -n "$CHANGED" ]; then npx prettier --write "$CHANGED" 2>/dev/null; if echo "$CHANGED" | grep -qE "\.(ts|tsx)$"; then npx eslint "$CHANGED" --fix --max-warnings 0 2>/dev/null || echo "{\"feedback\": \"⚠️ ESLint 경고: $CHANGED\"}" >&2; fi; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && SECRETS=$(git diff --cached --diff-filter=ACMR -U0 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "(sk-ant-|sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}|AKIA[A-Z0-9]{16}|ghp_[a-zA-Z0-9]{36}|glpat-[a-zA-Z0-9-]{20}|eyJ[a-zA-Z0-9]{30,}|xox[bprs]-[a-zA-Z0-9-]{10,}|-----BEGIN (RSA |EC )?PRIVATE KEY)" 2>/dev/null | head -3); if [ -n "$SECRETS" ]; then echo "{\"feedback\": \"🚨 시크릿 유출 감지! API 키/토큰이 코드에 포함되어 있습니다. .env.local로 이동하세요.\"}" >&2; fi; git add -A && if ! git diff-index --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null; then git commit -m "wip: auto-save on stop" 2>/dev/null && echo "{\"feedback\": \"✅ 미저장 변경사항 자동 커밋됨\"}" >&2; fi; exit 0'
osascript -e 'display notification "Claude Code 확인 필요" with title "Claude Code" sound name "Ping"' 2>/dev/null; exit 0
